hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Caribbean, island between the Caribbean Sea and Atlantic Ocean, north of Trinidad and Tobago || volcanic in origin with central mountains || Resources: timber, tropical fruit || Exports: nutmeg/cardamons, fish, wheat flours, frozen fruits and nuts, aqueous paints (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: volcanic in origin with central mountains || Caribbean, island between the Caribbean Sea and Atlantic Ocean, north of Trinidad and Tobago

climate.excerpt: tropical; tempered by northeast trade winds || lies on edge of hurricane belt; hurricane season lasts from June to November volcanism: Mount Saint Catherine (840 m) is on the island of Grenada; Kick 'em Jenny, an active submarine volcano (seamount) on the Caribbean Sea floor, lies about 8 km (5 mi) north of Grenada; these two volcanoes are at the southern end of the volcanic island arc of the Lesser Antilles that extends to the Dutch dependency of Saba in the north

economy.excerpt: small OECS service-based economy; large tourism, construction, transportation, and education sectors; major spice exporter; shrinking but still high public debt; vulnerable to hurricanes; emerging blue economy incentives || Exports: nutmeg/cardamons, fish, wheat flours, frozen fruits and nuts, aqueous paints (2023) || Industries: food and beverages, textiles, light assembly operations, tourism, construction, education, call-center operations
